title: Google-only parents crash every password path: BCrypt.Verify on an empty PasswordHash throws (login 500 + enumeration oracle; ChangePassword and DeleteAccount also 500)
scenario: Google sign-up sets PasswordHash="" (~1290); later email+password login finds the row and calls BCrypt.Verify(password, "") which in BCrypt.Net-Next 4.1.0 throws ArgumentException 'Invalid salt' → 500 instead of the uniform 401; throttle never records; 500-vs-401 reveals Google accounts. Same at ChangePasswordAsync (861) and DeleteAccountAsync (1339).
fix: PasswordMatches(hash, pw) => !IsNullOrEmpty(hash) && Verify; when empty still Verify against a dummy hash for timing; use at all three sites.

title: DeleteAccountAsync deletes the orphaned Device row, bricking the toy (Unlink keeps it by design)
scenario: Sole parent deletes their account → Device row removed → every device-authed call 401s forever; the printed QR points at nothing.
fix: Use the same factory-reset branch Unlink uses; keep the Device row.

title: Anonymize pass sets Email="" under the UNIQUE IX_Parents_Email index: the second anonymized parent throws and every later tick aborts
scenario: Latent (AnonymizeAfterDays=0 today). Second eligible parent → UNIQUE constraint → RunTickAsync throws forever; passes ordered after it never run again.
fix: Scrub to a unique placeholder like anonymized:{id:N}.

title: Factory reset on last unlink leaves DeviceInvite and DeviceUsageDay rows
scenario: Old family's invite can still join after a new family claims; usage counters carry over.
fix: RemoveRange DeviceInvite and DeviceUsageDay for the device in the last-link branch.

title: Google sign-in never normalizes the Google email: mixed case creates a duplicate Parent
scenario: identity.Email used verbatim (1198) while byEmail lowercases only the stored side (1235-1238); hosted-domain capitals → second Parent.

title: Today summary throws on a DST-gap local midnight for a parent-supplied tz
scenario: tz=Asia/Beirut on the spring-forward day → ConvertTimeToUtc(00:00) throws → 500 all day.
fix: If resolvedTz.IsInvalidTime(x) advance past the gap before converting.

title: Dormant-device delete has no DormancyWarnedAt > LastSeenAt guard
scenario: Latent (DeleteAfterDays=0). A toy warned long ago, revived, dormant again; re-warn fails that tick → deleted without a delivered warning.

title: Chat rate limiter partitions on the unauthenticated X-Device-Id header before DeviceAuthMiddleware: anyone with the toy's QR can 429 the real toy
scenario: UseRateLimiter (475) before DeviceAuthMiddleware (478); 30 bodiless POSTs/min with the victim id spend the window.
fix: Key on the authenticated id (HttpContext.Items) after auth, IP fallback; check what reordering the middleware would change for parent auth limiting.

title: Per-account lockout silently disables itself once 50,000 distinct emails have failed; nothing prunes other keys
scenario: Credential stuffing over 50k emails fills the map; afterwards no new key is tracked until restart.
fix: At the cap, prune entries with no active lockout and no failure inside the window first.

title: Operator session exchange has no rate limit and no TOTP replay guard
scenario: Leaked static token + online brute force of the 6-digit code (~10/s); sniffed code replayable within 90 s.
fix: [EnableRateLimiting(AuthRateLimiter.PolicyName)] on CreateSession; remember the last accepted TOTP counter per operator.

title: DB-health and audio-store alerts are transition-only, so a state bad from boot never alerts
scenario: Unmounted volume at deploy → unhealthy on every tick → no transition → no alert.
fix: Initialise the baselines to 'ok' so an initially-bad state alerts once.

title: False backup_stale alert on the first boot of an empty volume (alerter ticks immediately; backup worker waits a minute)
scenario: Fresh deploy → first alert is a false alarm.
fix: Same InitialDelay, or skip while uptime < 2×InitialDelay and when backups are disabled.

title: E-501 crash-looping can show for a toy that panicked once and later failed three syncs: wire bootCount is the sync-failure streak
scenario: One WDT weeks ago + three failed syncs during a backend outage → E-501 instead of E-401.
fix: Require the streak to have grown recently, or have firmware send the real boot counter (cable-flash).

title: A parent redeeming their own invite burns it with no effect
scenario: alreadyLinked true → no link but ConsumedAt stamped.
fix: Return true before touching ConsumedAt when alreadyLinked.

title: Seat limit is count-then-insert with no DB constraint
